simple.meaning: מָשַׁח (mâshach) appears 69 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with priesthood. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.

definitions.short: to rub with oil , i.e. to anoint ; by implication, to consecrate ; also to paint
